Article.ArticleTitle: Pembrolizumab versus Chemotherapy for PD-L1-Positive Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

Abstract.AbstractText: In KEYNOTE-024, 305 patients with untreated advanced NSCLC and PD-L1 tumor proportion score of 50% or greater were randomized. Median PFS was 10.3 months versus 6.0 months (HR 0.50; 95% CI 0.37-0.68; p<0.001). Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks. NCT02142738.
